facts.value: __ln_F[n] supplies a float approximation to ln(1+n/128), and __one_over_F[n] supplies 1/(1+n/128), to logf; the latter scales the residual rather than taking the reciprocal of the logarithm. __sincos_on_quadrant supplies axis and sign factors after angle reduction, while __sincos_poly supplies interleaved coefficients evaluated by sinf and cosf.
